figurative_meaning_en: Superficial, for public display or to impress others
example_sentences_in_bangla: লোক দেখানো করে কোনো লাভ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: All his actions are for show.
There's no point in doing it just for show.
note: Refers to actions done insincerely to gain public approval in Bengali social contexts.
